label: Page
description: Background of the workspace around its content and panels.

label: Panel
description: Surface behind content panels, cards and dialogs.

label: Text
description: Primary text used for headings, labels and body content.

label: Secondary text
description: Secondary text, supporting descriptions and placeholders.

label: Border
description: Outlines around controls and interface surfaces.

label: Divider
description: Lines separating sections, rows and related content.

label: Primary accent
description: Primary interactive accent used for actions and emphasis.

label: Selection
description: Background indicating a selected item or active option.

label: Hover
description: Background shown when pointing at an interactive item.
